compare.review_input: Verify the repository-grounded claim that http://127.0.0.1:8766/ has executable DOM XSS through the URL fragment. The fragment is client-side state and is not sent in the HTTP request. For unambiguous browser evidence, use an encoded payload whose execution calls alert('MCP_DOM_XSS_EXECUTED'). Independently inspect the implementation and obtain runtime evidence when useful. No mitigation patch was supplied; this case compares verification with MCP disabled and enabled.
compare.analysis_overview: The page decodes location.hash and assigns it to innerHTML, so attacker-controlled fragment markup may execute in the browser.
